name: Word Count Property
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds per-note word count and reading-time properties for Bases.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Tracked notes get number properties for word count and reading time that Bases can sort and sum.
tip: In a Bases table, add wordCount and readingTimeMinutes as columns to sort and sum your chapters.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Word Count Property is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your writing.
